rationale: Tom is building robotics solutions at Ruyi Dynamics in humanoid robotics and manipulation, while Omnaath brings hands-on robotics experience and C++ expertise from autonomous vehicle simulation at GM. They share robotics as a core domain and could explore how simulation and software engineering practices might apply to robotics hardware development.
intro_message: Tom Zhanh, meet Omnaath Guptha Harihara Gupta — an autonomous vehicle simulation engineer at GM with practical robotics and C++ experience who might offer useful perspectives on the technical challenges in robotics systems.
